info.title: WPSecScan scan-report
info.summary: Schema for the JSON document WPSecScan writes for each scan (item #53).
info.description: Machine-readable schema for the output of `wpsecscan <url> --json-only` and the `report.json` artefact bundled with every HTML / agency-dashboard run. Use this spec to generate typed SDKs (openapi-generator, openapi-typescript, etc.) without hand-rolling structs.

title.description: Short human-readable summary, e.g. 'WordPress version disclosed in generator meta tag'.

evidence.description: Raw byte-level evidence (HTTP response excerpt, file path, header value).

remediation.description: Step-by-step fix the operator should apply.

url.description: Specific URL on the target that produced this finding (may be empty for site-wide findings).

extra.description: Free-form structured detail. Common keys include `cve`, `cvss`, `wordfence_vid`, `wpvulndb_id`, `plugin_slug`, `plugin_version`, `proven`, `playbook`.

error.description: Populated if the check raised before completing; null on success.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock time for this single check.

SeveritySummary.description: Count of findings at each severity for the whole scan.

target.description: Root URL of the WordPress site that was scanned.

scanned_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which the scan started.

duration_ms.description: Total wall-clock time of the scan in milliseconds.

risk_score.description: Composite 0-100 score (higher = better posture) derived from wpsecscan.risk.compute_risk_score().
